identificationModule.briefTitle: MASCT-I Combined With Doxorubicin and Ifosfamide for First-line Treatment of Advanced Soft Tissue Sarcoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of MASCT-I Combined With Doxorubicin and Ifosfamide for First-line Treatment in Patients With Advanced Soft Tissue Sarcoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study will evaluate the safety and efficacy of MASCT-I combined with Doxorubicin and Ifosfamide for first-line treatment in patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a multicenter, randomized, open-label study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of MASCT-I combined with Doxorubicin and Ifosfamide for first-line treatment in patients with metastatic or recurrent unresectable advanced soft tissue sarcoma.

armGroups.label: MASCT-I+ Doxorubicin+ Ifosfamide
armGroups.description: The final products of MASCT-I technology are dendritic cells (DC) and effector T cells. DC cells injection will be given via subcutaneous injection, and T cells injection will be given via Intravenous (IV) infusion. Doxorubicin and Ifosfamide will be given per protocol.

armGroups.label: Doxorubicin+ Ifosfamide
armGroups.description: Doxorubicin and Ifosfamide will be given per protocol.

interventions.name: MASCT-I
interventions.description: The final products of MASCT-I technology are dendritic cells (DC) and effector T cells.

primaryOutcomes.description: The time from the date of randomization to the first occurrence of radiological progression or death, whichever comes first.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The time from the date of randomization to the date of death from any cause.

The percentage of participants with complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) via investigator assessment per RECIST (Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors Criteria) v1.1 relative to the total number of participants in the analysis population.
The percentage of participants with CR, PR, or stable disease (SD) relative to the total number of participants within the analysis population as determined by Investigators per RECIST v1.1.
The time from first documentation of response of PR or better to first documentation of disease progression or death from any cause, whichever comes first.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Adverse events and serious adverse events
